records.prompt: Build a small local stationery storefront called Paper Harbor. Include six products with names, prices and categories; search and category filtering; a cart with quantities, remove controls and a correct total; and a demo checkout collecting a name and email and showing an order confirmation. Keep the cart after a page reload. Use synthetic data, no accounts or real payments, and no external dependencies. Start it locally and give me the preview URL.
